'''Martonn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] inciter residing on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]-affiliated individual.

==Behind the scenes==
Martonn appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Dromund Kaas. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed by any Imperial character for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
